# Prospora Leads

> Qualified conversations. Real pipeline. Prospora Leads is a B2B lead generation, appointment setting, and research-led outbound sales agency helping ambitious teams reach verified decision-makers across the USA, Canada, the Middle East, and Australia.

## Core Information
- **Company**: Prospora Leads
- **Contact Email**: info@prosporaleads.com
- **Target Markets**: United States (USA), Canada, Middle East, Australia
- **Core Services**: B2B Lead Generation, Appointment Setting, Email Outreach, LinkedIn Outreach, Market & Account Research, Data Verification & Enrichment
- **Full Documentation for AI Agents**: [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt)
